location: gen:TRF009ShipShape property constraints for nltl:constructionStageDate, nltl:deliveryDate, and nltl:assessmentDate
problem: The candidate makes construction stage date, delivery date, and assessment date mandatory for every ship, including ships outside the IA Super/IA pre-1-September-2003 applicability condition. This changes the requirement into an unconditional data-completeness obligation and can reject otherwise non-applicable ships.
required_change: Apply these date cardinality requirements conditionally: require constructionStageDate when iceClass is IA Super or IA, and require deliveryDate and assessmentDate only when the ship is an applicable IA Super/IA ship constructed before 1 September 2003; ensure missing dates for an otherwise applicable ship cannot satisfy the conditional alternative.
regression_guard: Preserve the conditional scope of TRF-009 and do not impose deadline-related inputs on non-applicable ships.
